development.description: Accelerated campaign adaptation: each earned level grants every field crawler 3 points to allocate in the safe room. Existing automatic HP/mana growth remains for checkpoint compatibility. Strength adds damage every 2 points; Dexterity adds movement every 3; Constitution adds 3 maximum HP per point; Intelligence adds 2 maximum mana per point; Charisma adds 1 healing per point. These are game formulas, not book formulas. New caps require rest to refill. Skill practice comes only from committed personal/class abilities; rank bonuses affect direct ability damage/healing and mana costs, never reaction damage or items.

journey.label: Earth Descent — Floors 1–8
journey.description: An accelerated mixed-timeline tactical adaptation of the first eight floors within an eighteen-floor dungeon. Source-supported floor themes are simplified into authored grid maps; class progression, enemy conversions, XP and objective rules are game inventions. Floors 9–18 remain locked.

floors.label: First Floor — Tutorial Passage
floors.description: Rock-hewn tutorial survival inspires this compact training battle. Learn innate actions and movement before class selection. Source: https://dungeon-crawler-carl.fandom.com/wiki/First_Floor All enemy statistics, XP and grid rules are adaptations.

exploration.description: Explore the branching transfer corridors, inspect the briefing, and approach the marked door. Map geometry and interaction costs are adaptations.

points.label: Enter First Floor — Tutorial Passage
points.description: Enter after completing the visible exploration objectives. Battle and progression rules are tactical adaptations.

exploration.label: Over City — Lantern Row
exploration.description: Reach the pump-chamber entrance. Explore the workshop lane for supplies or take the rescue alley to help a trapped crawler. Both routes reconnect with the main street; optional choices never block the way down.

points.label: Pump-chamber boss entrance
points.description: Main objective: enter the existing Over City battle. Rescue is optional; a rescued crawler reveals how coolant and oil can help.

points.label: Safe-room entrance / street briefing
points.description: Lantern Row is an original scenario inspired by the idea of connected tabletop neighborhoods. Go east to the boss, north for the workshop and supplies, or south for an optional rescue. All routes reconnect.

points.label: Safe-room emergency shelf
points.description: One Health Tonic for the shared pack; original game adaptation.

points.label: Lantern workshop merchant
points.description: Optional once-only workshop exchange. Take free coolant or barter a tonic for a Fire Bomb. Original adaptation.

points.label: Trapped supply store
points.description: Optional environmental puzzle. Use coolant to neutralize the heated latch, or open the manual bypass for a smaller supply. Original adaptation.

points.label: Crawler under the shutter
points.description: Optional rescue: trained Heavy Blow lifts the shutter quickly; the free manual winch always works. Both reveal a coolant clue and reward supplies. Original adaptation.

floors.description: The Iron Tangle is a transport-navigation puzzle. This adapted transfer station requires inspecting a reachable route lever before entering battle; it does not simulate the full railway or a real-time six-hour stair window. Source: https://dungeon-crawler-carl.fandom.com/wiki/Fourth_Floor All enemy statistics, XP and grid rules are adaptations.

home.label: The party house
home.description: A shared personal space attached to a public safe room: individual bedrooms, a lounge, and separately installed training and crafting facilities.
home.economyNote: Gold income, the eight-bedroom bundle and once-per-floor paid training are game adaptations. Documented room offers retain their sourced prices; unknown membership prices are not purchase options.

upgrades.label: Shared personal space
upgrades.costNote: Base offer: 50,000 gold; the eight-bedroom bundle is a game adaptation.
upgrades.description: Open a private bedroom for each field crawler and the shared lounge.

upgrades.label: Training Room
upgrades.description: Unlock paid practice in eligible nonmagical skills. The book uses a daily time limit; this game allows one session per crawler per floor.

upgrades.label: Engineer’s Table
upgrades.description: Install a crafting worktable. Enables the two authored supply recipes in the story campaign; this recipe mapping is an adaptation.

upgrades.label: Enhanced Crafting Studio
upgrades.costNote: Published offer: 255,000 gold. Extra recipe output is a game adaptation.
upgrades.description: Upgrade the crafting room. Each completed recipe produces one extra unit of every output.

upgrades.label: Social Screen
upgrades.description: Install the lounge screen. Shows your local achievements, victories and captured-card record. The book’s moderated audience network is represented by this local record.

upgrades.label: Desperado Club
upgrades.description: Personal earned credentials; pets are excluded from the inner club. Eligible class credentials are handled separately, never sold as a universal party pass.
upgrades.eligibilityReason: Personal earned credentials; pets are excluded from the inner club. Eligible class credentials are handled separately, never sold as a universal party pass.

upgrades.label: Club Vanquisher
upgrades.description: Requires personal eligibility and respects conflicting memberships. Carl’s Emberus exception grants limited access in the story; this game does not award that quest automatically.
upgrades.eligibilityReason: Requires personal eligibility and respects conflicting memberships. Carl’s Emberus exception grants limited access in the story; this game does not award that quest automatically.

clubs.label: Desperado Club
clubs.description: This class provides an earned personal credential. Inner-club access excludes pets and depends on current eligibility. This prototype records the pass; a full club interior is not simulated.

neighborhood.label: Lantern Row
neighborhood.description: A sealed pump chamber blocks the way down. Explore the streets, stock up at the workshop, and help a crawler trapped in the rescue alley. Your choices decide which supplies reach the fight.

interactions.label: Workshop merchant
interactions.description: The merchant has one offer left for your party. Trade for firepower or take the coolant sample before heading to the pump chamber.

options.label: Barter a Health Tonic
options.description: Spend 1 Health Tonic; receive 1 Fire Bomb.

options.label: Take the free coolant sample
options.description: Receive 1 Coolant Bomb. No skill or payment required.

interactions.label: Heated supply latch
interactions.description: The supply latch is dangerously hot. Cool it to preserve the medicine inside, or use the manual bypass to recover a smaller supply.

options.label: Cool the latch
options.description: Spend 1 Coolant Bomb; receive 1 Mega Tonic and earn the supply-puzzle challenge.

options.label: Use the manual bypass
options.description: Receive 1 Health Tonic. No skill or payment required.

interactions.label: Optional crawler rescue
interactions.description: A crawler is pinned under a shutter beside a fragile supply pack. Heavy Blow lifts it cleanly; the manual winch rescues the crawler but crushes part of the pack.

options.label: Lift with trained Heavy Blow
options.description: Requires Heavy Blow at rank 1. Lift the debris without crushing the supply pack: receive 2 Shock Tonics and the boss clue.
options.clue: The pump chamber has a wet channel and oil patches. Wet targets conduct lightning; oil catches fire. The rescued crawler shares Shock Tonics to help you exploit the channel.

options.label: Turn the manual winch
options.description: Rescue without a skill requirement; receive 1 Shock Tonic and the boss clue.
options.clue: The pump chamber has a wet channel and oil patches. Wet targets conduct lightning; oil catches fire. The rescued crawler shares Shock Tonics to help you exploit the channel.

interactions.label: Lantern Row preparation
interactions.description: Mordecai has room for one supply package. Pack healing for a long fight, or coolant for the heated latch and lightning combinations.

challenges.label: Leave no crawler behind
challenges.description: Rescue the trapped crawler by either approach. Once per run: 1 Health Tonic.

challenges.label: A cooler solution
challenges.description: Neutralize the heated supply latch with a Coolant Bomb. Once per run: 1 Fire Bomb.

challenges.label: Plan before the plunge
challenges.description: Choose a safe-room preparation plan before exploring Lantern Row. Once per run: 1 Cleansing Tonic.
